title: Entitlement Days Given Back for a Reduced Term - Computation
content:
**Computation sheet — entitlement given back on a reduction of a Chapter 30, Chapter 35 or Chapter 1606 term, Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).**

**The reduced term.** The term measured is the term of the latest reduction reported on the benefit; its term start and term end are carried on the amendment, and the amendment carries the credits remaining.

**The days given back.** The entitlement days given back for a reduced term are the days of that term, from its term start to its term end with both days counted, multiplied by the daily charge of the credits certified less the daily charge of the credits remaining, and rounded half up to a whole day; they are never fewer than none.

**The daily charge.** A credit load is charged day for day: 1 a day while any credits are certified, and nothing once no credits remain. The daily charge of the credits remaining is therefore 1 when any credits remain and nothing when none remain.

| Credits remaining on the amendment | Daily charge certified | Daily charge remaining | Difference | Days given back on a 100-day term (hypothetical) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 1 | 1 | Nothing | 0 |
| 0 | 1 | Nothing | 1 | 100 |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A reduced term running from January 12 to April 30 of a non-leap year counts 109 days with both ends included. If the reduction leaves no credits, 109 days multiplied by 1 gives 109 days given back; if any credits remain, the difference is nothing and no days are given back.
